task: For two real signed 8x8 maps S,T, return every finite-board cross-correlation C[dy,dx]=sum S[y,x]*T[y+dy,x+dx], offsets -7..7; also sum C over eight knight offsets. This is an interaction computation, not reconstruction.
oracle: explicit finite-board offset slicing and dot products; independent knight enumeration
counterexamples: a1 versus b1 knight-source with fixed c2 target; equal Fourier magnitudes/powers, different knight relation; a1 to g2 wrap-only knight relation
failure_control: rook a1 horizontal reach for all128 blocker subsets on b1..h1; fixed unblocked linear kernel versus first-blocker-inclusive oracle
metrics: full225-output max absolute error and mismatching cases
knight scalar absolute error and mismatches
magnitude collision counts and distinct true correlations

timing.scope: same full225-output obligation; total encoding+composition+decode, and separately cached-channel composition+decode for spectral variants; Python/NumPy implementation, no optimized chess speed claim

limits: No engine, training, move-choice policy, Elo or novelty inference. Fourier phase is an experimental alignment representation, not a claim that JPEG stores arbitrary complex phase. No MDCT/TDAC implementation in this experiment.
